answer: Ephemeral assignment lottery.** Each epoch, an agent's duties derive from hashing its identity with a random beacon value published only after commitments close—so an attacker cannot precompute which identities will be selected or how many are needed. Duplicates multiply the odds of being assigned low-value work, not rewards. The ivory ledger records beacon seeds; opal markers flag repeated duty collisions. A fresh gale of randomness each round forces attackers to pay real registration and monitoring costs per identity while gaining no predictable advantage,
